run_training_loop: run the training loop for a specified number of epochs with a given model and dataset
run_validation: run the validation loop to evaluate model performance and compute PSNR loss metrics
save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optimizer states and epoch info to a specified path
resume_training: resume training from a saved checkpoint file and continue from the last epoch
handle_slurm_signals: handle SLURM SIGUSR1 signals to trigger job requeue and graceful checkpointing
